title: Healthy Body, Happy Days
summary: Practica el vocabulario del cuerpo y cómo expresar problemas de salud y dar consejos en inglés.
keyIdeas: Usamos 'I have got a...' para dolencias como 'headache', 'stomach ache' o 'cold'.
Usamos 'My (knee/arm) hurts' para decir que nos duele una parte del cuerpo.
Para preguntar qué le ocurre a alguien decimos: 'What is the matter?'.

activities.prompt: Match each body part with its description:
activities.explanation: Relacionamos cada parte del cuerpo con su función principal: los oídos para oír, los ojos para ver, el estómago para la comida y la rodilla en la pierna.

pairs.right: You listen to sounds with this.
You look at things with this.
It is in the middle of your leg.

activities.prompt: A thermometer shows that Aisha has a temperature of 38 °C. What is the matter?
activities.explanation: Una temperatura corporal de 38 °C o más se considera fiebre: «a fever». Aisha debe avisar a una persona adulta.
activities.hint: Piensa en qué palabra usamos cuando la temperatura del cuerpo sube mucho.
options: She has got a broken arm.

activities.prompt: «I have got a cough» means «Tengo tos».
activities.explanation: «A cough» significa tos. En este ejercicio practicamos cómo expresar un síntoma, sin indicar tratamientos.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct illness to complete the sentence:
activities.explanation: «My stomach hurts» significa «Me duele la barriga»: «a stomach ache».
activities.hint: ¿Qué parte del cuerpo procesa la comida y los dulces?
activities.sentence: Hugo says, «My stomach hurts». He has got a ___.

activities.prompt: Classify the words into Body Parts and Health Problems:
activities.explanation: 'Shoulder' (hombro), 'ankle' (tobillo) y 'elbow' (codo) son partes del cuerpo. 'Sore throat', 'headache' y 'toothache' son molestias o enfermedades.

activities.prompt: Doctor: 'Hello, Mateo. What is the matter?' Mateo: '___'
activities.explanation: A la pregunta 'What is the matter?' (¿Qué te pasa?), respondemos explicando el síntoma o dolor, como 'I have got a sore throat' (me duele la garganta).
activities.hint: El médico te pregunta qué síntoma o problema de salud tienes.
options: I have got a sore throat.

activities.prompt: Read the story and answer the questions:
activities.explanation: El texto narra la visita de Lucas a la enfermera escolar cuando no se encuentra bien.
activities.title: A Visit to Nurse Clara
activities.text: Today at school, Lucas is not feeling well during PE class. He is sitting on the bench. Nurse Clara comes to talk to him. 'What is the matter, Lucas?' she asks. Lucas touches his head and says, 'I have got a bad headache and my throat hurts.' Nurse Clara checks his temperature. Lucas does not have a fever, but he looks very tired. 'You need to drink fresh water and rest quietly in this chair,' says Nurse Clara. After thirty minutes, Lucas feels much better.

questions.explanation: En el texto, Lucas dice: 'I have got a bad headache and my throat hurts' (le duele la cabeza y la garganta).

questions.prompt: What does Nurse Clara tell Lucas to do?
questions.explanation: La enfermera Clara le aconseja beber agua fresca y descansar tranquilo en la silla.
options: Run three laps around the gym.
Drink fresh water and rest quietly.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct action word:
activities.explanation: Usamos el verbo 'hurts' (duele) cuando una parte del cuerpo causa dolor tras un golpe o tropiezo.
activities.hint: Buscamos la palabra que significa que algo duele.
activities.sentence: Martina tripped in the playground and her left knee ___.

activities.prompt: In this school, a teacher takes a sick pupil to the nurse. Put this example in order.
activities.explanation: En este ejemplo, el alumno avisa al profesor y recibe ayuda adulta. No todos los colegios tienen enfermería.
items: You tell your teacher that you feel sick.
Your teacher takes you to the school nurse’s room.
The nurse asks what is wrong and checks you.

activities.prompt: Omar has got a terrible toothache after lunch. What is the best advice for him?
activities.explanation: Omar debe contarle el dolor a una persona adulta para que le ayude a recibir atención dental.
options: He should tell an adult and get help from a dentist.
